liquidity.method: cross-sectional percentile of mean daily turnover

quality.method: listing age and size percentile against a judged durability read

heat.method: turnover jump confirmed against exchange data, never a single-day move

beta_strength.method: absolute OLS beta against AMEX:SPY, beta 2.0 reads 100

beta_stability.method: agreement of the beta estimate across the two halves of the window

independence.method: 100 - the OLS R-squared of daily returns on AMEX:SPY

candidates.name: Alphabet Class C
exclusion_reasons: duplicate_asset: Class A already holds the Alphabet slot

exclusion_reasons: redundant_with_member: the sector ETF adds nothing over its own leaders
